integrity: Explicit all-exponent proof and independent finite enumeration/complex Fourier spot checks; finite checks are not an all-exponent certificate, and no independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted threefold convolution over \(\mathbb Z/2^k\mathbb Z\) only, k>=1; the identity gives a constant-coefficient sixth Fourier moment but neither weighted sharp L2-to-L6 extension constants nor general even moduli. Priority may be subsumed by a more general older local norm-density formula.
title: Dyadic parabola triple convolution: a three-mass law and exact sixth Fourier moment
